gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-winky-sans: Funnel Display draws loopy, spaghetti-like lines that never vary in stroke. Winky Sans sits beneath it with capitals barely taller than its lowercase, so the big, short heading is where the pair earns its personality.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-yantramanav: Funnel Display is all uniform strands, its crossbars exactly as heavy as its stems, which gives headings a bold, expressive voice. And Yantramanav, a modern sans-serif with spacious gaps at its curve endings, does the quieter work of staying tidy underneath.
gen-gf-funnel-display-outfit: Outfit sets curves that finish well before they close, like cable bent into shapes, in a friendly, clean voice. And Funnel Display handles the loud, commanding moments, while Outfit takes the steadier ground with its moderate lowercase height.
gen-gf-funnel-display-plus-jakarta-sans: Tangled spaghetti on top, tidy lines below. Funnel Display has tall lowercase and expressive swagger, while Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its monoline curves well apart, so a long read stays crisp and precise.
gen-gf-funnel-display-sora: Sora reads precise and geometric, with no swell at the corners. Funnel Display is best when it's expressive and commanding, with its lowercase standing tall, while Sora's moderate height handles the quieter, steadier text.
gen-gf-funnel-display-space-grotesk: Funnel Display brings commanding, spaghetti-like strokes and a tall lowercase that make headlines hard to ignore. Space Grotesk then takes over with a constant-width ribbon of letters and counters that breathe, a moderate and geometric sans.
gen-gf-gabarito-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk reads clean and approachable, with no thick-and-thin modulation anywhere in its sans letters. Gabarito's one-nib look adds expressive character on top, and the two feel like a handshake and a wink.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-alpino: Alpino feels cozy and casual, tall bodied with short-looking ascenders. Gabarito's open terminals let its counters flow outward, which is the pair's strongest quality: a distinctive heading beside a relaxed, plain sans.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk reads neutral but lively, its bowls left unfinished on one side and its lowercase running tall against the capitals. Gabarito is the expressive one, drawn with a single nib, while Familjen stays quick.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-hind: Professional steadiness defines Hind, whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals and whose strokes run like a drawn string, never turning the c inward. Gabarito adds a distinctive, expressive nib-drawn heading over it.
